comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Force of Orichalcum Memorial Album, this weapon requires the following to create it:

Lunar-crested Knife + Orichalcum x1 + Seal of Sorcery x20 + Seal of Gnome x5
Rank 10 Alchemy + Casting skills
Completion of the "Egypt & Atlantis" story quest from the Atlantis chain to unlock Transmutation Alchemy

Stats:

Throwing Knife-type weapon
Throwing +1
Assault +1
Evasion +1
20k total fame to equip

It can be further upgraded into Blitz EX -- further details available on respective pages. Cheers.
